name: Loyal Tech and Security
website: https://loyaltechsecurity.com/ (behind a Cloudflare bot check; a second, thinner site also exists at https://loyaltechandsecurity.com/)
what_they_do: Managed IT services and cybersecurity for small and mid-size businesses: security assessments, threat detection, incident response, monitoring, network/VPN/cloud work and outsourced IT support. Formerly known as Zunist Tech and Security.
customers: Small and medium businesses needing managed IT and cybersecurity, plus one-off security projects.

size_signals.signal: Google profile 4.8 rating, category 'Computer support and services', 197 NJ-18 East Brunswick
Owner post on the Google profile dated November 12, 2026 about a Microsoft 365 outage - profile is actively maintained
Recruiting a Business Development Representative via an external job board
Secondary site lists hours Monday to Friday 9am-5pm

listing.reviews: count not shown in Google's limited Maps view

website_review.primary_cta: None reachable - the main domain serves a Cloudflare 'Verifying you are not a bot' interstitial instead of the site
website_review.trust_signals: Only visible on the secondary domain: hours, phone, generic cybersecurity copy; no testimonials, certifications or named staff
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Primary domain is gated by a Cloudflare challenge for automated visitors (still showing after waiting, at both desktop and 390px width); the secondary domain has a single H1 of 'Home', no schema and a demo-theme credit ('Design: Newspaperly WordPress Theme')
website_review.search_basics: Secondary site title 'World's Leader in Managed IT Services' has no town or local qualifier; H1 is 'Home'; no JSON-LD; no substantive service pages. Primary domain cannot be evaluated
top_issues: Main website is unreachable to crawlers and AI agents behind a Cloudflare bot challenge - the 4.8-rated profile links into a verification wall
Two competing domains (loyaltechsecurity.com and loyaltechandsecurity.com) splitting authority and confusing NAP
No contact form, no quote request and no click-to-call reachable on the secondary site
Hours conflict between listing and site (9-5 weekdays on site vs 9-6 Mon-Sat in a directory), which an answering agent would get wrong

agent_readiness.notes: Google profile is the strongest asset seen in this batch: claimed, with hours, phone, website and fresh owner posts. But the site itself returns a Cloudflare interstitial to automated fetches, so no crawlable services, hours or service area exist for an AI agent to quote, and robots.txt cannot even be read. No form or booking path is reachable; the only channel is a tel: link on the secondary domain.

operations_signals.signal: Hiring a Business Development Representative suggests outbound lead generation is being scaled manually
Owner posts service/outage advisories manually to the Google profile
Inconsistent hours across listing and site - staff likely field 'are you open' calls

top_opportunities.opportunity: Unblock and consolidate: put one canonical domain in front of a stack that allows verified crawlers (Googlebot, OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot) through, and 301 the duplicate domain.
top_opportunities.evidence: Chrome at 1440px and 390px both got 'Performing security verification' instead of the site; a second domain serves near-duplicate, thinner content.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Build a real quote/booking path: service pages, a labelled 'Get a security assessment' form, and an AI intake agent that qualifies business size and stack then schedules a call.
top_opportunities.evidence: No form or booking exists on either domain; the only CTA is a tel: link, and they are hiring a BDR to do this manually.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Publish hours, service area and MSP plan tiers as text (plus LocalBusiness JSON-LD) so the 4.8-rated profile and the site agree.
top_opportunities.evidence: Hours differ between site and directory; no schema and no pricing anywhere.

scores.reasons: Gap: excellent profile, blocked and duplicated website. Pay: small MSP with likely retainer revenue and an open sales hire. Ease: crawler allow-listing and a form/agent are a week or two of work. Evidence: I saw the challenge page directly at both widths and read the secondary domain.

customers: Small businesses and local consumer brands (testimonials reference a fitness business, a health company and a writer's brand).

size_signals.signal: Client testimonials name 'Eileen and team'; site calls itself 'a boutique agency'
Google Maps shows 'Identifies as women-owned' and a suite at 485C US Highway 1 South, Iselin

listing.reviews: count not shown in limited view

website_review.trust_signals: Six named client testimonials, brand logo strip (Verizon, Firestone, Sprint etc.), women-owned attribute on the Google profile
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Copyright reads '© 2020'; theme and stock imagery date from 2019-2022; no meta description; viewport set with maximum-scale=1 which blocks pinch-zoom
website_review.search_basics: Page title is only 'Home - Key Marketing Agency' - no service, no town; no meta description; nav has just Home/About/Services/Contact
top_issues: Copyright and design four-plus years stale, which reads as inactivity
No meta description and generic 'Home -' title; no town in titles
Address mismatch: directories show 1 Tower Center Blvd (a PMB suite) while Maps lists Iselin - confusing for local search

agent_readiness.notes: robots.txt is the Yoast default with 'Disallow:' (nothing blocked) plus a sitemap. One JSON-LD block present. Tel link and a Calendly link mean an agent could book a consultation without a phone call. GBP looks claimed (photos, women-owned attribute, 5.0) but hours/services detail is thin and the profile address does not match the directory address.

operations_signals.signal: Consultations are phone calls booked through Calendly with no intake questions, so each call needs a human to qualify from scratch

top_opportunities.opportunity: Refresh the stale site (2020 copyright, no meta description, generic titles) and add service+town pages
top_opportunities.evidence: '© 2020 Key Marketing Agency' in the footer; title 'Home - Key Marketing Agency'; meta description absent

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add pre-consultation intake automation so booked calls arrive with a project brief
top_opportunities.evidence: Only booking path is the Calendly phone consult; no intake form anywhere on the site

top_opportunities.opportunity: Reconcile the Google profile address/hours and complete services so local and AI answers match the website
top_opportunities.evidence: Maps lists 485C US Highway 1 South, Iselin; directories list 1 Tower Center Blvd East Brunswick, PMB 30

scores.reasons: Visible decay plus address confusion makes the gap large; boutique agency with modest budget, but the work is straightforward and the problems are directly observable.

name: Kilmer Driving School
what_they_do: State-licensed driving school offering the 6-hour behind-the-wheel course for 16-year-olds, permit paperwork, road-test packages with a refresher and use of the school car, plus lessons for adults and newly arrived immigrants. Offers free pickup and drop-off and covers much of central New Jersey.
customers: Teen learners and their parents, adults getting licensed, and immigrant drivers; Middlesex County and surrounding towns.

size_signals.signal: Google rating 4.9 from 1,089 reviews - very high inquiry/throughput volume for a single office
License # 000293 displayed on the services page; instructors speaking English, Spanish and Arabic
Open 9 AM-5 PM seven days a week, office visits by appointment only

website_review.primary_cta: 'Contact Kilmer Driving School Today!' text link to a contact page
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: None - appointments by phone; 'Office Visits by Appointments Only'
website_review.trust_signals: State license number, 4.9 rating with 1,089 reviews, described course content and insurance-discount certificate
website_review.out_of_date_signs: HTTPS fails outright (certificate not trusted, so Chrome shows a warning and the page did not render); footer reads '(c) 2016 Kilmer Driving School'; WordPress defaults still in the sidebar (Recent Comments, Archives, Categories, Meta, Log in); logo uploaded 2016; contact page contains no address, phone, hours or form
website_review.search_basics: Page titles are page name plus brand (e.g. 'Contact | Kilmer Driving School'); no meta description found in the HTML I fetched; no JSON-LD found; service pages exist for courses, written-test practice and directions but the site is HTTP-only.
top_issues: Site cannot be loaded over HTTPS - the certificate is invalid, so visitors and crawlers see a warning
Contact page is effectively empty: no form, no address, no phone number in the text
Copyright stuck at 2016 and default WordPress sidebar widgets still exposed

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: Maps profile is strong (category, address, phone, hours 'Closed, opens 9 AM', 1,089 reviews) and robots.txt only disallows /wp-admin, but the website itself is HTTP-only with a failing certificate, which undercuts any agent that tries to open it. Answerable: prices, course contents, hours and license number are real text on the services page; there is no structured data and the phone number is not printed on the home or contact page (the logo links to tel:732-895-2911, a number that matches nothing else). Bookable: no form and no online booking anywhere - everything is phone and in-person appointment.

operations_signals.signal: 'Office Visits by Appointments Only' and a 24-hour cancellation/rescheduling request - inference: a person manages the lesson diary by phone
Road-test service requires contacting the school three weeks before the test date; scheduling is coordinated manually
Permit process needs birth certificate/passport, Social Security card and blue card brought to the office by a parent - document checking is done in person
1,089 Google reviews implies very high lesson volume feeding one phone line and one office

top_opportunities.opportunity: Rebuild the web front door: valid HTTPS, a real contact page with address/hours/phone and a labelled lesson-booking form (pickup town, course, preferred times)
top_opportunities.evidence: HTTPS certificate fails and the contact page has no form, address, phone or hours

top_opportunities.opportunity: Booking and reminder agent for lessons and road tests: proposes slots, enforces the 24-hour cancellation rule, sends reminders and coordinates road-test dates
top_opportunities.evidence: Appointments-only office, 24-hour cancellation request and 'contact us 3 weeks before the road test'

top_opportunities.opportunity: Permit-document intake wizard (checklist, upload, appointment slot) so parents arrive with complete paperwork
top_opportunities.evidence: Course page lists the exact documents required and requires an in-office appointment

scores.reasons: Gap: worst in the batch - no HTTPS, empty contact page, no booking. Ability: very high review volume at ~$390-640 per student, single office. Ease: rebuild plus booking agent, medium effort. Evidence: prices/hours/licence read from text pages, but the site could not be rendered because of the certificate error, so layout judgements are limited.

name: Fotoplicity
what_they_do: Portrait photography studio run by photographer Jennifer Evans, specializing in headshots (corporate, ERAS residency, Rutgers students), family/children's portraits, women and maternity sessions, and seasonal 'mini' sessions. Sessions are shot in-studio at 180 Tices Lane or outdoors.
customers: Central NJ families, women/maternity clients, students (Rutgers), and professionals/companies needing headshots.

size_signals.signal: Solo-owner studio with one named photographer (Jennifer Evans) and one studio suite address
Limits bookings by design: 'I work with a limited number of families each month'
Active blog and seasonal promotions (Fall minis sold out, Holiday minis booking)

listing.platform: Google/other map listing not retrievable (bot check)

website_review.primary_cta: CONTACT button in header plus 'Book a headshot session' buttons; phone 732-917-7748
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Contact/quote form only; no calendar-based online booking seen
website_review.trust_signals: Named photographer with bio page, testimonials, 57 photos, press mention (NJ Voyager) in blog
website_review.search_basics: Title 'Fotoplicity' (no service or town); meta description names headshot/portrait studio in East Brunswick NJ; services have their own pages (headshots, family, maternity, minis)
top_issues: Home page title tag is just the brand name - no service or town
No online self-serve booking; every inquiry routes to a form or phone call
Hero section on desktop rendered faded/empty until images load, weakening first impression

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: Squarespace-standard robots.txt blocks GPTBot/ClaudeBot/Google-Extended but allows OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot and Googlebot. Answerable: address, phone, hours and services are real text plus 3 JSON-LD blocks including LocalBusiness with address and opening hours (hours string malformed: 'Mo 09:00-12:00, Tu ..., , Th ..., Fr ...'). Bookable: labelled form fields, no CAPTCHA wall, but no scheduling - an agent cannot pick a slot.

operations_signals.signal: Owner promises reply to form inquiries within 24 hours 'usually much sooner' - manual inbox triage
Limited monthly session slots and weekend slots that 'go first' - capacity managed by hand
Many session types and seasonal mini launches, each needing its own inquiry handling and waitlist

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add self-serve online booking/scheduling with deposit for headshots and mini sessions
top_opportunities.evidence: Only a contact form and phone are offered; site uses 'book' language but no calendar exists

top_opportunities.opportunity: Inquiry triage + auto-reply/waitlist agent so the 24-hour response promise holds without owner time
top_opportunities.evidence: Contact page promises reply within 24 hours and mentions limited monthly slots and weekend sell-outs

top_opportunities.opportunity: Fix title tags and LocalBusiness schema (clean hours) to rank for 'headshots East Brunswick NJ'
top_opportunities.evidence: Home page title is only 'Fotoplicity'; openingHours string in JSON-LD is malformed

scores.reasons: Gap: no online booking and weak title tags, but site is modern and content-rich. Ability: solo owner-operator studio with mid-ticket session fees. Ease: Squarespace site, small scoped fixes. Evidence: inspected at desktop and 390px.

name: Elite Packaging Corp.
what_they_do: Packaging supplier and contract packager: packers and sleeves, hand assembly, refurbishing and shrink wrapping (per its own site); directory listings add die cutting, gluing and paperboard folding/set-up box work. Also listed as a corrugated box wholesaler/manufacturer.
customers: Local manufacturers, consumer-goods brands and wholesalers buying boxes and hand-assembly work.

size_signals.signal: Single small facility at 21-A Cotters Lane with hours Mon-Fri 9-5 (directory)
One sales email (sale@elitepkg.net) and one phone line on the site
Macrae's Blue Book lists additional capabilities (die cutting, gluing, folding/set-up boxes)

website_review.primary_cta: None - site returns a 403 Forbidden page to our requests
website_review.trust_signals: None usable on the live site
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Site returned 'Forbidden / You don't have permission to access this resource'; search-indexed copy of the same domain describes a minimal 'under construction' page
website_review.search_basics: No usable page content to rank; the only service description indexed is a short home page blurb; no title/meta/schema visible beyond the 403 page
top_issues: The site is effectively down for outside visitors (HTTP 403), so customers and crawlers see nothing
No capability or product pages, no quote form - all business must come by phone or word of mouth
No hours, no service area and no photos/trust content anywhere findable

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: the domain answers with 403 Forbidden to our requests, so robots.txt could not be read and content cannot be crawled. Answerable: only a phone number and sales email reach a visitor; services appear only in directory listings. Bookable: no form, no quote request, no online presence to act on - everything requires a phone call.

operations_signals.signal: All business flows through one sales email and phone line - manual quote handling for every job
Capabilities are documented in third-party directories rather than on their own site, implying ad-hoc collateral
Contract packing work (hand assembly, shrink wrapping, refurbishing) is inherently job-ticket based - inference: paper or spreadsheet job tracking

top_opportunities.opportunity: Get any real website live again: 5 pages (capabilities, box styles, industries, about, quote) with a working quote form - currently 403/under construction
top_opportunities.evidence: elitepkg.net returns 'Forbidden'; indexed copy describes a minimal under-construction page

top_opportunities.opportunity: Quote intake + acknowledgement agent (specs/quantity -> quote, follow-up) to replace the single sales@ inbox
top_opportunities.evidence: Only one sales email and phone are published for all inquiries

top_opportunities.opportunity: Claim and complete directory/Google listings with hours, categories and photos so the business is findable at all
top_opportunities.evidence: Only thin third-party directory entries (YellowPages, Macrae's) describe the business

scores.reasons: Gap: the website is effectively broken (403) and there is no online presence to speak of. Ability: small contract packager, low ticket sizes, limited budget signals. Ease: a simple site plus quote form is quick work. Evidence: site unreachable directly; findings lean on directory listings and search-indexed copy of the site.

name: Prestige Nails

customers: Local retail customers, families with children, gift-card buyers

size_signals.signal: Six service groups with itemised prices and a little-angels (kids) menu published on one page
Google profile is claimed and the owner posted a promo update 2 days ago

listing.reviews: count not exposed in Maps limited view; directory mirrors show 192-448

website_review.primary_cta: BOOKING button in the header (goes to a third-party scheduler); floating call button on mobile
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Yes - third-party scheduler at www.lldtek.org/salon/appt, choose by date or by technician
website_review.trust_signals: Full price list, hours, salon/result photos, gift-card promo, Facebook page
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Template leftovers: a stray (813) 654-4663 phone link in the header, 'Townsh' typo in the intro blurb, and a gift-card flyer modal that covers the whole first mobile screen
website_review.search_basics: Title and meta description name the salon, service and town. Services sit on one service.html page split by query string, not individual pages. No LocalBusiness JSON-LD found. robots.txt returns 404 (nothing blocked).
top_issues: Gift-card image modal blocks the first phone screen
Stray out-of-area phone number linked in the header
Services on one page via query strings; no LocalBusiness/Service schema
Booking hands off to a plain third-party scheduler that asks for a mobile number first

agent_readiness.notes: Claimed, active Google profile; robots.txt 404 so nothing blocks crawlers. Prices, hours and services are real text. No structured data. Online booking exists but on a separate generic scheduler page with no schema or service text.

operations_signals.signal: Appointments run through a third-party system while walk-ins still arrive at the desk
Reviews mention appointment delays and inconsistent service quality

top_opportunities.opportunity: Fix the site: kill the blocking promo modal, remove the stray (813) number, publish each service group as its own page with LocalBusiness + Service schema, and keep booking + call above the fold

top_opportunities.evidence: High review volume with repeated comments about waits and inconsistent service

top_opportunities.opportunity: AI front-desk assistant on the site to answer price/service questions and take bookings after hours
top_opportunities.evidence: No chat/FAQ on the site; booking only through a third-party page

scores.reasons: Decent site and claimed profile reduce the gap, but template defects and a weak booking hand-off are real. Runs gift-card promo marketing and has steady review volume, so some budget exists. Fixes are quick and well evidenced from the live site.

name: Parkway-Kew Corporation
what_they_do: Precision wear-coating and machining shop: HVOF, plasma spray and metalizing coatings, hardfacing and welding, component repair/rebuild (wire drawing blocks, fracking plungers, crane wheels) and manufactured wear parts, since 1952.
customers: Heavy industry, wire drawing, oil and gas, steel and OEM maintenance engineers across North America and internationally

size_signals.signal: In business since 1952; 'trusted by more than 500 companies across North America and beyond'
CNC turning to 72 in diameter, grinding to 65 in diameter by 12 ft length - a substantial in-house machining envelope
Member of WAI, Inc.; listed in the NJMEP manufacturing directory

website_review.primary_cta: Request a Quote (sticky button plus header phone)
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Two labelled quote/engineering request forms; no calendar or customer RFQ portal
website_review.trust_signals: Est. 1952, 500+ companies, WAI membership, capability pages with process specs, FAQ, own facility photography, 2026 copyright, hours in the header
website_review.out_of_date_signs: None obvious; on mobile the hero photo sits behind near-invisible dark headline text
website_review.search_basics: Excellent: descriptive titles/descriptions naming process and North Brunswick, separate capability pages (thermal spray, hardfacing, rebuilding, wear parts), Organization + LocalBusiness + Breadcrumb JSON-LD matching the page, robots.txt open with sitemaps
top_issues: No Google rating or reviews and the GBP is unclaimed with no hours
Mobile hero headline has almost no contrast against the building photo
Quote intake is free text; no drawing upload or structured RFQ

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: GBP has the right category and site link but is unclaimed ('Claim this business') and lacks hours; robots.txt allows everything. Answerable: standout - LocalBusiness JSON-LD with telephone, founding date and address, plus hours ('Mon to Fri, 8 am to 5 pm ET') as text and long-form capability copy. Bookable: labelled quote forms (name, company, email, phone, component, project notes) with no CAPTCHA, but no scheduling or drawing upload.

operations_signals.signal: Quotes start with 'send a drawing or dimensions' by email or form, so engineers read and price every enquiry by hand
The Restore & Grind programme (5-7 repairs per block) implies per-part tracking that is likely manual (inference)

top_opportunities.opportunity: Claim and complete the Google Business Profile (hours, services, photos, review requests) - there is no rating at all today
top_opportunities.evidence: Maps shows no rating, no hours, and a 'Claim this business' prompt

top_opportunities.opportunity: Structured RFQ intake with drawing/file upload and an AI first pass that asks for alloy, wear pattern and quantity
top_opportunities.evidence: Contact page asks customers to 'send a drawing, dimensions, or a brief description' via a free-text form

top_opportunities.opportunity: Fix mobile hero contrast so the value proposition is legible on a phone
top_opportunities.evidence: 390px screenshot shows dark headline over a dark building photo

scores.reasons: Gap 2: site already strong; gaps are GBP, RFQ structure and mobile contrast. Pay 4: 70-year industrial coater with 500+ customers and high-value repair work. Ease 4: static, modern, well-structured site. Evidence 4: home, contact, robots, schema and GBP checked.
